test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following Acts was provided for the establishment of a federal court in India?

options.text: The Government of India Act of 1935
The Government of India Act of 1919

solution:
The correct answer is __**The Government of India Act of 1935**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Government of India Act of 1935** was a landmark legislation introduced by the British Parliament.
 
• This Act provided for the establishment of a **Federal Court in India**, which began functioning in **1937.**
 
• The Federal Court was established to resolve disputes between the **central government** and the **provincial governments** and to hear appeals from High Courts.
 
• The Federal Court served as a precursor to the **Supreme Court of India**, which was established post-independence in **1950.**
 
• It had original, appellate, and advisory jurisdiction, bringing a new judicial structure to India.
 
• The Act also proposed the creation of an All-India Federation consisting of **British Indian provinces** and **princely states**.
 
• This legislation introduced significant reforms, including the introduction of provincial autonomy and the separation of powers between the **executive** and the **judiciary.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **The Regulating Act of 1773**__

 __
 
• The **Regulating Act of 1773** was the first attempt by the British Parliament to regulate the affairs of the East India Company in India.
 
• It established a **Governor-General of Bengal** and a Supreme Court in Calcutta but did not provide for a Federal Court.
 
• Its main aim was to curb corruption and mismanagement within the East India Company.
 
 
 
• **The Indian Councils Act of 1909**__
 __
 
• Also known as the **Morley-Minto Reforms**, this Act introduced reforms in the legislative councils.
 
• It allowed for the inclusion of **Indians** in legislative councils but did not address the judiciary or provide for a Federal Court.
 
• This Act aimed to increase Indian representation in governance rather than judicial reforms.
 
 
 
• **The Government of India Act of 1919**__
 
 
• This Act, also known as the **Montagu-Chelmsford Reforms**, introduced the concept of **dyarchy** in provincial governments.
 
• It focused more on **administrative reforms** and provincial autonomy and did not provide for the establishment of a Federal Court.
 
• Its primary objective was to prepare Indians for gradual self-governance.
